title: Work Challenges
content: Started my new job at Bright Horizons Accounting. Feeling overwhelmed with the new environment and the social interactions required. Trying to find ways to cope and fit in without getting too stressed.

title: Daily Reflections
content: Had a tough day at work today. The social aspects of the job are the hardest part for me. I'm working on some strategies to help, like taking short breaks and practicing mindfulness.

title: Bright Moments
content: Despite the challenges, there are bright moments. I completed a complex report today and my supervisor acknowledged my attention to detail. It felt good to be recognized for my strengths.
